$description: CredCare v9 component contracts. Source for Figma component sets; not synced (Figma unavailable).

components.name: Button
components.use: Primary action on a screen or sheet
components.spec: min-height 52 · radius r-md · label callout 15/600 · fill b700 · pressed scale .97
components.accessibility: role=button · aria-disabled with a visible reason line · hold has a tap path and a confirm dialog

components.name: Ledger row
components.use: One entry in a list: task, event, account or payment
components.spec: min-height 72 · padding 12/20 · mark 24 · title headline · amount mono-l right
components.accessibility: button or link · swipe has an equivalent tap · amount read with the title

components.name: Payment card
components.use: The account you are paying from or about to pay
components.spec: ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 · 1.586 : 1 · radius 14 (3.7% of width) · facets one hue · chip 38×28
components.accessibility: aria-label carries bank, product, last four and the amount; the facets are aria-hidden

components.name: Week strip
components.use: Seven days of the statement cycle
components.spec: day cell 44×76 · mark 28 · legend row below
components.accessibility: each day is a button labelled "Mon 2 Feb, paid on time"

components.name: Phase stack
components.use: The three phases of the plan, one on top
components.spec: page radius r-xl · peek 56 / 112 · strip 44 · edge 4 in the phase colour
components.accessibility: each strip is a button; dots announce phase, name and state

components.name: Score band track
components.spec: height 6 · marker 4×16 · four band segments · labels 300/550/700/900
components.accessibility: role=img with the band named in text as well as colour

components.name: Printer loader
components.use: A wait that takes seconds, not milliseconds
components.accessibility: role=status aria-live=polite; reduced motion shows the lines already printed

components.name: Stamp
components.accessibility: role=img with the word as its label

components.name: Sheet
components.use: A task that needs the account in view
components.spec: radius r-xl · padding 28/20/16 · grabber 36×4 · scrim n900 at 32%
components.accessibility: role=dialog aria-modal · grabber has a close button beside it

components.name: Toast
components.use: Confirmation you can undo, or an error you can retry
components.spec: min-height 48 · radius r-md · e2 · 96 above the tab bar
components.accessibility: role=status; the action is a real button

components.name: Field
components.spec: padding 9/16 · focus ring 2 b600 · error ring 2 er600 · message footnote er700
components.accessibility: label tied to the input; the message is referenced by aria-describedby

components.name: Tab bar
components.use: The five places in the app
components.spec: docked · no shadow · inset hairline · item min-height 56 · bottom padding 34
components.accessibility: aria-current=page; the badge is read as a count
